leads.title: 2007 Pew Global Attitudes Project
leads.documents: Level of societal non-acceptance of homosexuality in Mali - 98% of Malian adults said society should not accept homosexuality, highest rate among 45 countries surveyed.
leads.detail: Cited as '2007 Pew Global Attitudes Project' covering 45 countries; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Constitution of Mali (2023)
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on same-sex marriage; limits marriage to union of one man and one woman.
leads.detail: Adopted by referendum in June 2023, in effect since 2023; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Mali New Penal Code - Transitional National Council
leads.documents: Criminalization of homosexuality since 2024 and prohibition of undefined 'promotion' of homosexuality; increase in arbitrary arrests, detentions and physical abuse based on appearance/gender expression.
leads.detail: Passed 31 October 2024 by Transitional National Council; went into effect 13 December 2024; announced by Justice Minister Mamadou Kassogue; no URL visible in text

leads.title: U.S. Department of State on Mali - 'attacks on morality' laws
leads.documents: Enforcement use of morality laws to target LGBTQ persons and that they are actively enforced.
leads.detail: Cited as 'The United States Department of States points to laws in Mali which prohibit "attacks on morality"'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Mali Penal Code (prior) Article 225 - public indecency
leads.documents: Pre-2024 vague provision penalizing 'public indecency' frequently used to target LGBTQ individuals and those with nonconforming gender expressions.
leads.detail: Cited as 'Article 225, which penalizes "public indecency"'; no URL visible in text

leads.title: Code des Personnes et de la Famille, Article 522
leads.documents: Family law ban forbidding same-sex couples from adopting children.
leads.detail: Passed by National Assembly 2 December 2011 and signed by president of Mali; no URL visible in text

leads.title: U.S. Department of State 2011 Human Rights Report - Mali
leads.documents: Rights machinery and freedom of association: no publicly visible LGBT organizations; association 'for an immoral purpose' prohibited; 2005 governor of District of Bamako refused recognition to gay rights association.
leads.detail: Cited as 'U.S. Department of State's 2011 human rights report'; 2005 Bamako governor decision cited; no URL visible in text

leads.title: ARCAD/SIDA - Dr. Dembele Bintou Keita
leads.documents: Living conditions for men who have sex with men (MSM): intolerance, no rights to claim sexual orientation, negative cultural beliefs, forced marriage/bisexuality and underground practices raising HIV/STI risk.
leads.detail: Director of ARCAD/SIDA HIV/AIDS organization providing health care for MSM; no URL visible in text
